rationale: C20 plausibly supplied a material drafting template: both letters use a third anniversary as the occasion to renew official appreciation for the people responsible for a defense-related program, praise their contributions to its success, and extend congratulations. C05 and C08 share the concluding machinery of asking an intermediary to convey appreciation or commendation to all participants, but neither has C20's distinctive anniversary framing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The third anniversary of Operation Skywatch on July fourteenth affords me an opportunity to express once again my respect and admiration for those citizens
shared_material.parent_excerpt: On this third anniversary of the adoption by Congress of the Greek-Turkish aid program, I desire to express once again the Government's appreciation of your important role
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared construction: a third anniversary supplies the occasion to 'express once again' appreciation for contributors to a program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As you mark the third anniversary of Skywatch, please convey to all Ground Observers past and present my personal word of appreciation and congratulations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The third anniversary ... provides an appropriate occasion to extend congratulations and to express the appreciation of the Government to the many American men and women ... who have contributed to the achievements of that program
shared_material.explanation: Both combine anniversary commemoration, congratulations, appreciation, and recognition of the broader group whose service made the program successful.

shared_material.child_excerpt: they have helped to deter aggression
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This victory has preserved the freedom of Greece and enhanced the security of the United States and of the free world.
shared_material.explanation: The praised service is tied in both letters to a broader national-security achievement, reinforcing the parallel rhetorical structure.
